description.title: מכלול - הגבלות אחריות
description.summary: This table details limitations of liability under the 'מכלול' insurance policy. It specifies scenarios where the insurer's responsibility may be limited, particularly concerning claims involving the National Insurance Institute.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת 'מכלול' מגדירה הגבלות אחריות במקרים של תביעות מהמוסד לביטוח לאומי, כגון תשלומים שלא שולמו או דיווח שגוי על עובדים. ההגבלות מתייחסות גם לעובדים דרך חברות כוח אדם או קבלנים, כולל חשבוניות ותאגידים בבעלותם. סעיפים אלו נועדו להבהיר את היקף הכיסוי הביטוחי.

description.column_axis: Description of the limitation of liability

7.3.2.6  In respect of and/or in connection with any claim -
7.3.2.6.1 By the National Insurance Institute in regard to an injured person, for whom the insured is required to pay National Insurance Institute contributions and fails to do so, or failed to report to the National Insurance Institute that such person is its employee, as required by law.
7.3.2.6.2 By the National Insurance Institute regarding a person who worked or provided service to the insured through a manpower company or contractor, including a subcontractor, or against invoices or a corporation owned by him.

טבלה: מכלול - הגבלות אחריות
This table details limitations of liability under the 'מכלול' insurance policy. It specifies scenarios where the insurer's responsibility may be limited, particularly concerning claims involving the National Insurance Institute.
ממדים: Specific claim scenarios related to National Insurance Institute, Description of the limitation of liability

7.3.2.6  In respect of and/or in connection with any claim -
7.3.2.6.1 By the National Insurance Institute in regard to an injured person, for whom the insured is required to pay National Insurance Institute contributions and fails to do so, or failed to report to the National Insurance Institute that such person is its employee, as required by law.
7.3.2.6.2 By the National Insurance Institute regarding a person who worked or provided service to the insured through a manpower company or contractor, including a subcontractor, or against invoices or a corporation owned by him.
